results.relevance: This allele is strongly associated with GPA/PR3-ANCA vasculitis. Absence is atypical for PR3-ANCA disease.
This allele has been associated with MPO-ANCA vasculitis in some studies.
Deficiency variants (ZZ) are associated with increased PR3-ANCA risk. Normal result is non-contributory.

interpretation: Genetic profile is more consistent with MPO-ANCA associated vasculitis than PR3-ANCA/GPA.
